title: A high-performance reagent-less sensor based on copper(II) phthalocyanines supported by multi-walled carbon nanotubes for phosphate detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8156-8168
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00350D, Paper
Open Access

Malak Talbi, Adiraju Anurag, Christoph Tegenkamp, Mounir Ben Ali, Olfa Kanoun
A new reagent-less method for the detection of phosphate. Carbon screen printed electrodes were modified with copper phthalocyanines offered excellent electrocatalytic properties, with carbon nanotubes to enhance the electrocatalytic performance.
